A.method: Claude Code agent, pass A: searched each paper for the question's metric and dataset terms, then read the matching table or sentence in the pypdf page text (docs/AGENT_EXTRACTION.md).

arcene_auroc.reason: Table 2, row SAINT, column Arcene (4th dataset column); AUROC in %.

bank_marketing_accuracy.reason: The Bank column of Table 2 reports AUROC (accuracy is given only for the multi-class columns marked with a dagger); the paper reports no accuracy for Bank.

xgboost_arcene_auroc.reason: Table 2, row XGBoost, column Arcene (4th dataset column); AUROC in %.

B.method: Claude Code agent, pass B, made after pass A in the same session (NOT independent of A): searched each paper again from the start, first for the row or sentence that names the model, then for the column or value. Each re-search confirmed A's answer, so B's values, units, and pages were taken over from A; B's quotes (whole rows) and reasons were copied again from the pypdf page text (docs/AGENT_EXTRACTION.md, section 3).

arcene_auroc.reason: Row SAINT of Table 2, 4th value (columns: Bank Blastchar Arrhythmia Arcene ...), AUROC in %.

bank_marketing_accuracy.reason: Table 2's Bank column is AUROC; accuracy is reported only for the dagger-marked multi-class datasets.

xgboost_arcene_auroc.reason: Row XGBoost of Table 2, 4th value (Arcene), AUROC in %.
